name: Red Linen Goods
summary: At Eastvale Logging Camp, Sara Timberlain needs linen for her tailoring. She asks you to recover bandanas from Defias bandits so she can keep making goods for travelers.

sections.title: Bandits and Burlap
sections.body: Across Elwynn, Defias bandits wear red linen bandanas. Their less organized kin in Northshire make do with cheap burlap masks. The linen gives Sara workable cloth for her tailoring.

sections.title: Salvage at the Camp
sections.body: At Eastvale Logging Camp, Sara Timberlain needs textiles for her trade. Taking bandanas from Defias camps scattered through the woods supplies her with cloth and helps check the bandits' encroachment.

faq.q: Who offers the Red Linen Goods quest?
faq.answer: Sara Timberlain, a seamstress at Eastvale Logging Camp in eastern Elwynn Forest, asks you to bring her cloth.

faq.q: What items are needed for Red Linen Goods?
aliases: what do i collect for red linen goods
faq.answer: You need six Red Linen Bandanas from Defias gang members scattered throughout Elwynn Forest.

faq.q: Where can I find Defias bandits in Elwynn Forest?
faq.answer: Defias outlaws camp across Elwynn Forest, including around Brackwell Pumpkin Patch, Stonefield Farm, and the woods around Jerod's Landing.

faq.q: Why do the Elwynn Defias wear linen instead of burlap?
faq.answer: Low-ranking Defias in Northshire wear burlap masks, while better-equipped members across Elwynn wear red linen. The bandanas mark the Brotherhood's greater organization and supply.

faq.q: Why does Sara Timberlain want bandit bandanas?
aliases: what does sara do with masks
faq.answer: Sara Timberlain needs fabric for her tailoring. She reuses linen from Defias masks to sew practical goods for woodsmen and travelers at the logging camp.

faq.q: Where is the Eastvale Logging Camp located?
faq.answer: Eastvale Logging Camp lies in far eastern Elwynn Forest, just north of the main road toward the bridge into Redridge Mountains.

angles.text: As a tailor, you know how scarce fabric can lead a seamstress to salvage cloth from bandits' clothing.
As an Alliance traveler, you can weaken the Defias Brotherhood in Elwynn while bringing useful cloth to Eastvale.
